prompt:
The section file sections/header-menu-defaults.liquid renders the store's header navigation. The markup must stay byte-for-byte unchanged. The schema has wrong or missing default values, so a freshly added section renders badly. Replace the {% schema %} JSON with exactly this schema, keeping keys in this order.

Top-level keys:
- "name": "Header menu"
- "tag": "header"
- "settings": an array of exactly five settings, in this order:
  1. type "link_list", id "menu", label "Menu", default "main-menu" (hyphen, not underscore).
  2. type "text", id "menu_label", label "Menu label", default "Main menu".
  3. type "select", id "alignment", label "Alignment". Its options are, in order: {"value":"left","label":"Left"}, {"value":"center","label":"Center"}, {"value":"right","label":"Right"}. Its default is "left", which must be one of the option values.
  4. type "checkbox", id "sticky", label "Sticky header", default true (a JSON boolean).
  5. type "range", id "item_spacing", label "Item spacing", min 8, max 40, step 4, unit "px", default 16. All of these are JSON numbers, and the default must fall on a step.

There must be no other keys: no presets, no blocks and no extra settings. Change only sections/header-menu-defaults.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
